title: Seafood Paella
description: Rice cooked flat in a wide pan and never stirred, so the bottom layer caramelises into socarrat. The seafood goes in late and stays whole.
notes: Use the widest pan you own. Depth is the enemy — the rice should sit no more than two grains deep.

ingredients.name: saffron
ingredients.note: bloomed in a little hot stock

steps.text: Sear the prawns and squid briefly in the olive oil and set them aside — they will finish later.
In the same pan, cook the onion and garlic down, then add the grated tomatoes and sweet paprika and reduce to a dark sofrito.
steps.tip: The sofrito should be jammy and almost dry. This is where most of the flavour lives.

steps.text: Stir in the bomba rice and coat it in the sofrito.
Pour in the hot fish stock and the bloomed saffron, spread the rice level, and do not stir again.
steps.tip: From this point a spoon is forbidden. Stirring releases starch and you get risotto.

steps.text: Cook at a strong simmer, turning the pan for even heat.
Push the mussels into the rice hinge-down, return the prawns and squid to the top, and cook until the liquid has gone.
Raise the heat for the last minute to build the socarrat — listen for it crackling.
Rest off the heat under a cloth, then serve with lemon wedges.
